title: Fused Aromatic Network with Exceptionally High Carrier Mobility
notes: Spine: need -> fused-network hypothesis -> HAB+PTK pyrazine design, TFMSA route -> condensation -> pyrazine-fused bonding and ABC-stacked 2D lattice -> (branch A: drop-cast/stamped flakes over a thickness sweep -> on/off rises as flakes thin; conjugation/pi-stacking MEC -> 996/501 cm2/Vs mobility -> highest-in-class comparison) and (branch B: HCl physisorption doping, 20-160 C vapour exposure -> conductivity ~7 -> ~1e3 S/cm, adsorbed-dopant MEC) -> conclusion. Audits: o6 (ABC minor reflections missing), o9 (strong O 1s), o18 (pristine flake conductivity from F4b already ~260-450 S/cm, at odds with 'two orders over pristine'), n28 (multilayer flakes). Mobility numbers are text only (Table S5). F3b isotherm cited as whole figure because its crop carries a false 'micrograph' OCR cue. F4 is tier C (no panels offered): cited with panel_ids [].
